goal: Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy an upgrade there, press REBIRTH once you can afford it, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair
summary: The playtester's plot was claimed automatically (plots_claimed 1, auto_claims 1) and cash rose steadily. It opened the SHOP and bought Dropper 2 and the speed upgrade (steps 15 and 17), and rebirthed successfully at step 13 (HUD 'REBIRTH x1.5!', next cost $10000, rebirths=1). The trace doesn't show the Dropper 2 pad walk-on itself, but dropper_bought=3 and conveyor_bought=2 suggest pads were bought. The TOP TYCOONS board was read at every step and consistently shows a wrong cash value. The Gold tier Buy button also never fired.

bugs.title: TOP TYCOONS board shows $1T cash for the player
bugs.evidence: At steps 2-18 the BackPanel reads '1 | retailtycoonlover21 | R0/R1 | $1T' while the HUD shows Cash 2.5K, 5.2K, 54, 222 and so on. The value does not track real cash, either before or after the rebirth. leaderboard_refresh=64, so the board does update but with a bad value.

bugs.title: Gold tier 'Buy' button in the shop does not fire
bugs.evidence: Steps 1, 6 and 7 pressed Card_tier_gold.State ('Buy' at 739,744), both by path and by text, with cash 2.4K-3.6K. Each time the result was done=False, 'button did NOT fire'. Other shop buttons (dropper2 and speed1) fired normally. Either the button is blocked or unresponsive, or the price is not clear to the player. tier_upgrades=1 suggests the purchase may have worked once.

bugs.title: No visible feedback when REBIRTH is pressed while unaffordable
bugs.evidence: Steps 4, 9 and 18 pressed REBIRTH at 59%, 78% and 2% progress. The button fired and rebirth_denied reached 8, but the observations show no message explaining the denial. This is a possible confusion point for new players.

bugs.title: Tutorial is re-shown repeatedly
bugs.evidence: The counters show tutorial_reshown=6 against tutorial_done=2 and tutorial_steps=2. A new player may see the tutorial pop up again and again. The trace does not show what triggers it.
